notes: The ✕ on RapTech in Alt+Tab or on the taskbar now always puts the timer in the notification area, and the Close and minimise buttons option is gone. An ✕ button is back on the launcher's bar after the staff cog, putting the timer in the notification area with the time still running. The launcher keeps three layouts, Shelf, Modern and Arcade; a terminal set to Library or Deck switches to Shelf · Frost. The Show Desktop strip option on the Security page is removed and the strip is left alone. The launcher also stops drawing after five seconds behind any window that covers it, not only a fullscreen game.
